title: Rav Chanan bar Ami (II)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Avodah Zarah 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.38a.7), Rav Chanan bar Ami cites Rabbi Pedat in the name of Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman distinguishes him from the Rav Chanan bar Ami who was Shmuel’s student, arguing: how could he speak in the name of Rabbi Pedat, son of Rabbi Elazar, the student of Rabbi Yochanan? In [Berakhot 55b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.55b.7), Rabbi Huna bar Ami speaks in Rabbi Pedat’s name. Hyman reports that Ein Yaakov reads Rav Chana bar Ami. Hyman gives Rav Chana bar Abaye for [Pesachim 101a:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.101a.10) and proposes the reading as in [Avodah Zarah 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.38a.7).[^2] In Eruvin 67a: Rav Chanin bar Ami in the name of Ulpana or of Chilfa.

notes.text: The consulted [Berakhot 55b:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.55b.7) calls the speaker Rav Huna bar Ami and continues the chain from Rabbi Pedat to Rabbi Yochanan. Hyman’s shorter quotation and his reported Ein Yaakov reading are retained.

The consulted Pesachim reads Rabbi Chanin bar Abaye, while Avodah Zarah has Rav Chanan bar Ami. Both give the chain through Rabbi Pedat in Rabbi Yochanan’s name, on different subjects. Hyman’s proposed reading and his report of Ein Yaakov remain distinct.
